set.body:
Scope

Add S06, S08, S09, S13 extension, and S18 as public acceptance scenarios.

Acceptance criteria

- [x] S06 covers a factor plus continuous modulator under grand/within-cell centering, per-cell/shared slopes, missing-value policies, and audit receipts.
- [x] S08 covers a fully crossed 3x3 design with stable level ordering, unequal ordinal scores, linear/quadratic trends, interaction trends, and omnibus tests.
- [x] S09 assigns canonical, informed, and FIR bases to different structural cells with heterogeneous widths and no manual offsets.
- [ ] S13 distinguishes shared, run-specific, and separate/fixed-effects models over mixed acquisition grids and validates cross-run hypotheses.
- [x] S18 proves WLS against square-root-weighted OLS and an independent external/direct reference.
- [x] Scenario generation does not use the compiler under test to create end-to-end truth unless explicitly labelled a solver-only test.
- [ ] Each completed scenario asserts structural columns, policies/audit, numerical results, and provenance; remaining scenarios must meet the same bar.
- [x] No raw design matrix or numeric contrast bookkeeping appears on the completed public workflow paths.
- [ ] Manifest entries identify the exact reference layer and include reproducible receipts for every planned scenario.
- [ ] All planned scenarios return clean Pass and run on JVM and Scala.js.
